## 0.2.225

owes: a TLS broker whose chain passes the JDK's default trust store for the `mqtt.host` name is now trusted without a fingerprint and survives renewal (reach it by the certificate's name; an `extra_hosts` line or local DNS entry where the name resolves publicly), and any other certificate keeps the confirmed-fingerprint flow unchanged; *Test connection* now subscribes to `#` for 3 s and stores `mqtt.restriction`, `mqtt.restriction_seen` and `mqtt.restriction_checked_at` in `hub_state` (dropped when the endpoint changes), so a broker ACL log will show that one wildcard subscription; no migration, rollback safe.
owes: none — the headless engine (`:engine`, contract `engine/1` kept) gains the feed management, notes, weather and stocks methods and a hub session with relays to `/api/v1`; it never reaches the image, and the weather, notes-search and quote-chain codecs moved into `:payloads` with package names kept; no migration, key, wire format or default changes on the hub.
owes: more routes under `/api/v1` — users, devices, modules, health, about, settings, restart, broker, snapshots and update for an administrator, and feed, weather and stocks helpers for a user — each on its page's reader and writer; a reverse proxy must pass `Authorization` on `/api/` and allow large bodies on `/api/v1/snapshots/upload`; the stocks import page now answers `413` instead of `500` for a statement above its 1 MiB form cap; `/api/v1/stocks/api-key` is not shipped (`specs/DECISIONS.md` 33); no migration, key or default changes, rollback safe.
owes: new routes under `/api/v1` (a bearer session at `/api/v1/session`, own-account routes) answer JSON for a signed-in user, and `GET /hub/status` now also answers `apps` and `homeApp` on the device token; a client that sends a session token to `/sync/*` or `/hub/status` is refused, and a reverse proxy must pass the `Authorization` header on `/api/`; no migration, key or default changes, rollback safe (an `api:` session simply stops working).
owes: none — a new hub-free `:payloads` module takes the feed, notes and stocks payload codecs, the notes conflict-copy id and `orderKey` rules, the stocks alert rule and a Markdown parser, with package names kept and every call site unchanged; no wire format, key, migration or default changes.
